user_saw: A plugin author could receive a temporary file path outside the directory they requested when a UUID override contained traversal segments.
summary: The fix uses shared fs-safe helpers to reject unsafe UUID overrides and stage downloads with Windows-safe filenames.
reasoning: At the July 1 shallow boundary, the public SDK already exported the helper, and the helper interpolated the trimmed UUID into a joined path without validating it. The September dot-segment fix left UUID handling unchanged, and the offline history stops at the shallow boundary, so I could not verify whether the unsafe handling shipped with the override or replaced an earlier working implementation.
